globalAlerts.warning: BUILD FIRST: Always run `make build` before running scripts. The osm binary must be up-to-date.
TEST AFTER EVERY CHANGE: Run `go test -short -count=1 -timeout=5m ./...` after each significant change to catch regressions early.
ZERO TOLERANCE: Tests must be isolated -- no host state mutation, no external dependencies, no flaky timing-dependent tests.
PLATFORM COMPATIBILITY: All code must work identically on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
JAVASCRIPT SCRIPTS: All app-specific functionality MUST be modeled as JavaScript scripts using the osm runtime.
PTY TESTS: All PTY tests use termtest.NewConsole and must respect unix build tag. Slow tests must use testing.Short() skip guards.
RULE OF TWO: Every commit must pass two contiguous issue-free subagent reviews before being committed.
ADVERSARIAL AUTOPSY SOURCE: ./scratch/impl-gaps-pull-out-hackery-proper-ecosystem/ contains the full adversarial analysis with file paths and line numbers.
DEPENDENCY ORDER IS MANDATORY: Tasks are sequenced so that later tasks depend on earlier ones. Do not reorder without updating this blueprint and logging the deviation.
DECSC/DECRC SPEC NOTE: Per xterm specification, CursorVisible and MouseTracking/MouseSGR are NOT part of the DECSC/DECRC save/restore set. These modes are intentionally excluded.
GO AS REUSABLE MODULES: Go code must be exposed as reusable, modular implementations accessible via osm script. Never hardcode application-specific logic.
JS FOR APP-SPECIFIC LOGIC: All application-specific functionality MUST be modeled as JavaScript. Don't do anything in Go that someone else couldn't do using OSM.
THIN SHIM PRINCIPLE: JS scripts should be thin configuration shims that wire up Go utilities -- like socat wiring up core utilities, not like a monolithic application.

sequentialTasks.task: Fix DECRQM missing mode 4 (Insert Mode) and mode 1001 (Highlight Tracking)
sequentialTasks.description: DECRQM in internal/termmux/vt/csi.go silently returns status=1 (unknown) for mode 4 (InsertMode) and mode 1001 (HighlightTracking) because these cases are not in the switch. Both mode flags exist on Screen. Add case 4 and case 1001 to the DECRQM handler that check the corresponding Screen field and return status 2 (set) or 3 (reset). Also added case 1003 (MouseTrackingAnyEvent) to DECRQM, and case 4 (InsertMode) to decset/decrst handlers. Files: internal/termmux/vt/csi.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: CSI ?4$p returns status 2 when InsertMode=true, status 3 when InsertMode=false. CSI ?1001$p returns status 2 when HighlightTracking=true, status 3 when HighlightTracking=false. At least 4 new DECRQM tests covering both modes.

sequentialTasks.task: Fix doc.go BracketedPaste contradiction and DA2 formatting
sequentialTasks.description: doc.go has a contradiction: line 122 says BracketedPaste 2004 is 'Supported' but line 167 says 'Not yet (mode flag only)'. The mode flag IS supported (DECSET/DECRST 2004 works), but the actual \x1b[200~ / \x1b[201~ paste delimiters are never emitted by VTerm.Write() during paste processing because VTerm.Write() has no paste entry point that checks the mode. Fix: change line 122 to 'Supported (mode flag only; paste delimiters not yet emitted by VTerm)' and update line 167 to match. Also fix DA2 entry: 'DA2> -- Extended DA -- Supported' is misleading because the '>' is an intermediate byte, not a separate feature. Fix: 'DA2 (CSI >c) -- Secondary Device Attributes -- Supported'. Files: internal/termmux/vt/doc.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: No contradiction in doc.go about BracketedPaste. DA2 entry clearly describes CSI >c with intermediate byte. All other entries accurate.

sequentialTasks.task: Fix duplicate comment in InsertLines (screen.go:879)
sequentialTasks.description: screen.go line 879 has a duplicate sentence in the InsertLines comment: 'InsertLines inserts n blank lines at the cursor row within the scroll region. inserts n blank lines at the cursor row within the scroll region.' Fix: remove the duplicate sentence. Files: internal/termmux/vt/screen.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: InsertLines comment has no duplicate sentence. Single clear description.

sequentialTasks.task: Add OSC/DCS buffer overflow warning
sequentialTasks.description: parser.go silently drops bytes when oscBuf or dcsBuf exceeds maxOSCLen/maxDCSLen. The truncated payload is dispatched to the callback with incomplete data and no warning. Fix: add a counter or optional callback for overflow events. At minimum, add a Debug-level log when overflow occurs. The maxOSCLen and maxDCSLen are defined in defaults.go. Files: internal/termmux/vt/parser.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: OSC/DCS buffer overflow emits a debug-level log or increments a counter. Callback still receives truncated payload (no behavior change for valid-length sequences). At least 2 tests verifying overflow handling.

sequentialTasks.task: Replace fmt.Fprintf with strconv.AppendInt in render.go hot path
sequentialTasks.description: RenderFullScreen in render.go uses fmt.Fprintf(&b, '\x1b[%d;1H', r+1) for each row, which allocates internally. For a 24-row terminal this is 24 allocations per full-screen render. Replace with strconv.AppendInt to avoid fmt overhead. Files: internal/termmux/vt/render.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: RenderFullScreen uses strconv.AppendInt instead of fmt.Fprintf. Benchmark shows measurable allocation reduction for full-screen render. All existing render tests pass.

sequentialTasks.task: Add DECRQM mode 4/1001 tests and Screen.Clear() comprehensive test
sequentialTasks.description: Add tests for: (1) DECRQM for mode 4 (InsertMode) set/reset, (2) DECRQM for mode 1001 (HighlightTracking) set/reset, (3) Screen.Clear() verifies all 40+ fields are reset to zero-value defaults. Screen.Clear() is called by VTerm.reset() on RIS and is critical for correctness. Files: internal/termmux/vt/decrqm_test.go (extend), internal/termmux/vt/screen_test.go (extend).
sequentialTasks.acceptance: DECRQM mode 4 test: query returns 2 when set, 3 when reset. DECRQM mode 1001 test: query returns 2 when set, 3 when reset. Screen.Clear() test: all fields zeroed/default after Clear(). At least 8 new tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add 256-color palette and UTF8 edge case tests

sequentialTasks.task: Remove 3 empty stub methods from PaneManager interface and paneManager
sequentialTasks.description: PaneManager interface in layout.go declares SplitHorizontalAction(), SplitVerticalAction(), and CloseActivePane() which are empty stubs in paneManager that do nothing. These are AI slop -- methods that exist in an interface but have no implementation violate the interface contract. The actual split/close operations are handled by SessionManager.NewPane/ClosePane, not by the pane manager. Remove the 3 stub methods from both the PaneManager interface and the paneManager struct. Update any callers. Files: internal/termmux/layout.go, internal/termmux/pane_manager.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: PaneManager interface has no empty stub methods. paneManager struct has no empty method bodies. All callers compile. All existing tests pass.

sequentialTasks.task: Add padRight/padLeft/padCenter to osm:unicodetext module
sequentialTasks.description: Extended the existing osm:unicodetext module with padRight, padLeft, padCenter functions instead of creating a new osm:fmt module. These use uniseg.StringWidth for proper Unicode-aware width calculation. No new module registration needed since unicodetext is already registered. Files: internal/builtin/unicodetext/unicodetext.go (extended), internal/builtin/unicodetext/unicodetext_test.go (extended).
sequentialTasks.acceptance: require('osm:unicodetext') loads without error. padRight('hello', 10) returns 'hello     '. padLeft('hello', 10) returns '     hello'. padCenter('hello', 10) returns '  hello   '. Unicode-aware: CJK characters counted as width 2. At least 4 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add termmux.newBoundedSession JS binding
sequentialTasks.description: Add a newBoundedSession factory to the osm:termmux module that creates a CaptureSession AND a SessionManager in one call, wiring them together. This replaces the 20+ lines of manual session setup in bouncing-logo.js. Signature: termmux.newBoundedSession({cmd: '/bin/sh', args: [], rows: 24, cols: 80, name: 'session', kind: 'capture'}). Returns an object with .session, .mgr, .sid properties. The caller still needs to call mgr.run(), mgr.started(), mgr.activate(sid). Files: internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: termmux.newBoundedSession({cmd: '/bin/sh', rows: 10, cols: 30}) returns {session, mgr, sid}. session is a CaptureSession wrapper. mgr is a SessionManager. sid is a SessionID. mgr.run() + mgr.started() + mgr.activate(sid) work. At least 4 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add termmux.newBounceController JS binding
sequentialTasks.description: Add a newBounceController factory to osm:termmux that manages pane bouncing behavior. The controller handles: position (paneX, paneY), velocity (velX, velY), bounds clamping, pause/resume, pane size adjustment, tick updates. Signature: termmux.newBounceController({speed: {x: 1, y: 1}, paneSize: {w: 32, h: 12, minW: 12, maxW: 62, minH: 7, maxH: 32, step: 2}, controlsHeight: 2}). Methods: tick(width, height) updates position, togglePause(), bigger(), smaller(), paused(), paneX(), paneY(), paneW(), paneH(), bounceCount(). This replaces 44 lines of JS bounce physics. Files: internal/builtin/termmux/bounce.go (new), internal/builtin/termmux/module.go (register).
sequentialTasks.acceptance: newBounceController creates a controller with specified config. tick() updates position and bounces off walls. togglePause() freezes/resumes bouncing. bigger()/smaller() adjust pane size. All accessor methods return current state. Bouncing stops at screen boundaries. At least 10 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add termmux.enableMouseForward JS binding
sequentialTasks.description: Add an enableMouseForward function to osm:termmux that handles the full mouse forwarding chain: check if child enabled mouse tracking (DECSET 1000/1002/1003) -> compositor hit-test -> screen-to-pane coordinate translation -> mouseToSGR encoding -> mgr.input(). This replaces 160 lines of repeated per-event-type JS code. Signature: termmux.enableMouseForward({sessionManager: mgr, sessionId: sid, compositor: comp, paneId: 'pty', paneX: fn, paneY: fn, paneW: fn, paneH: fn, borderWidth: 1}). Returns a forward(msg) function that takes a BubbleTea mouse event and handles it. The forward function checks mouseTracking from snapshot, does hit-testing, translates coords, encodes SGR, and calls mgr.input(). Files: internal/builtin/termmux/mouse_forward.go (new), internal/builtin/termmux/module.go (register).
sequentialTasks.acceptance: enableMouseForward returns a forward function. forward(mouseClickEvent) checks mouseTracking, does hit-test against paneId, translates coords, encodes SGR, calls mgr.input(). When mouseTracking=0 (child hasn't enabled mouse), forward is a no-op. Works for Click, Motion, Release, Wheel event types. Coordinate translation subtracts pane origin and border width. At least 8 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add termmux.newControlRouter JS binding
sequentialTasks.description: Add a newControlRouter factory to osm:termmux that provides declarative key-to-action routing with chord mode support. Signature: termmux.newControlRouter({keys: {'ctrl+p': 'pause', 'ctrl+b': 'bigger', ...}, chordMode: {prefix: 'ctrl+x', actions: {'s': 'smaller', 'b': 'bigger', ...}}}). Returns a router object with handleKey(key) method that returns {handled: bool, action: string} and handleChord(key) method for chord resolution. This replaces 35 lines of JS if-chain + chord state machine. Files: internal/builtin/termmux/control_router.go (new), internal/builtin/termmux/module.go (register).
sequentialTasks.acceptance: newControlRouter creates a router from a declarative key map. handleKey('ctrl+p') returns {handled: true, action: 'pause'}. handleKey('a') returns {handled: false, action: ''} (unhandled keys pass through). Chord mode: handleKey('ctrl+x') enters chord mode, next handleKey('s') resolves chord. handleKey('ctrl+x') then handleKey('esc') cancels chord. At least 8 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add compositor.addBoundedPane and compositor.renderBordered JS bindings
sequentialTasks.description: Extend the osm:termui/compositor module with two new features: (1) addBoundedPane({id, sessionId, bounds, bordered, style, z}) adds a pane that auto-updates from a session's snapshot -- eliminates the remove+re-add pattern. (2) renderBordered(content, style, width, height) renders content inside a lipgloss-bordered frame at given dimensions -- eliminates the borderStyle.width(w).height(h).render(ansi) pattern in JS. Files: internal/builtin/termui/compositor/module.go (extend).
sequentialTasks.acceptance: addBoundedPane creates a pane that tracks session snapshot content. renderBordered renders content inside a bordered lipgloss frame. At least 4 tests for each function.

sequentialTasks.task: Rewrite example-15-bouncing-logo.js as thin shim using new Go bindings
sequentialTasks.description: Rewrite the 704-line bouncing-logo script to approximately 100 lines using the new Go-side bindings: termmux.newBoundedSession, termmux.newBounceController, termmux.enableMouseForward, termmux.newControlRouter, compositor.addBoundedPane, compositor.renderBordered, and osm:fmt. The rewritten script should: (1) declare config (colors, dimensions), (2) create a bounded session in one call, (3) create a bounce controller, (4) set up compositor with bounded pane, (5) enable mouse forwarding, (6) declare control key routing, (7) wire event bus listeners, (8) define BubbleTea model with thin update/view that delegates to Go controllers. The script must support mouse input (via enableMouseForward) and all existing functionality (pause, bigger, smaller, quit, chord mode, resize). Files: scripts/example-15-bouncing-logo.js.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: Script is approximately 100-120 lines (down from 704). Supports mouse input via enableMouseForward. All existing functionality preserved: pause/resume, pane size adjustment, quit, chord mode, resize, compositor rendering, zone-based buttons. Script runs without error via osm script. At least 1 manual smoke test.

sequentialTasks.task: Add copy mode vi-like navigation key bindings
sequentialTasks.description: VTerm has EnterCopyMode/ExitCopyMode/SelectStart/SelectEnd/SelectedText/CopySelection/ScrollUp/ScrollDown but no vi-like navigation key bindings for moving the cursor in copy mode. Add a CopyModeKeyHandler (similar to PaneKeyHandler) that maps keys when in copy mode: h=left, l=right, j=down, k=up, Ctrl+U=half page up, Ctrl+D=half page down, g=top of scrollback, G=bottom of scrollback, 0=beginning of line, $=end of line, w=next word, b=previous word, q=exit copy mode, Space=start selection, Enter=copy selection and exit. This is a Go-side component that can be wired from JS. Files: internal/termmux/copy_mode_keys.go (new).
sequentialTasks.acceptance: CopyModeKeyHandler maps vi keys to copy mode actions. HandleKey('j') returns action ScrollDown(1). HandleKey('Ctrl+U') returns action ScrollDown(halfPage). HandleKey('q') returns action ExitCopyMode. HandleKey(' ') returns action SelectStart. HandleKey('Enter') returns action CopyAndExit. At least 12 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add copy mode search functionality
sequentialTasks.description: Add incremental search to copy mode. When in copy mode, pressing / enters search-forward mode, ? enters search-backward mode. The search query is accumulated character-by-character. Pressing Enter jumps to the next match. n jumps to next match, N jumps to previous match. Search operates on the scrollback buffer (VisibleLines). The search highlights matches by setting a SearchMatch attribute on matching cells. Files: internal/termmux/vt/screen.go (add SearchForward/SearchBackward/NextMatch/PrevMatch methods), internal/termmux/copy_mode_keys.go (add search key handling).
sequentialTasks.acceptance: SearchForward('pattern') finds the next occurrence in scrollback and scrolls to it. SearchBackward finds previous. NextMatch/PrevMatch cycle through matches. Search matches are highlighted visually. Search works across scrollback boundaries. At least 8 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add copy mode page navigation and line scroll
sequentialTasks.description: Add PageUp, PageDown, HalfPageUp, HalfPageDown, ScrollToTop, ScrollToBottom navigation methods to VTerm copy mode. These complement the existing ScrollUp(n)/ScrollDown(n) which only scroll by n lines. Add keyboard actions to CopyModeKeyHandler: Ctrl+B=page up, Ctrl+F=page down, Ctrl+U=half page up, Ctrl+D=half page down. Files: internal/termmux/vt/vt.go, internal/termmux/copy_mode_keys.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: PageUp scrolls by Rows lines. PageDown scrolls by Rows lines. HalfPageUp scrolls by Rows/2 lines. HalfPageBottom scrolls by Rows/2 lines. ScrollToTop sets ScrollOffset to max. ScrollToBottom sets ScrollOffset to 0. All clamped to valid range. At least 6 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add main-horizontal and main-vertical layout modes
sequentialTasks.description: tmux has 'main-horizontal' (one large pane on top, remaining panes small and stacked below) and 'main-vertical' (one large pane on left, remaining panes narrow and stacked on right). Add LayoutMainHorizontal and LayoutMainVertical to the LayoutMode constants and implement computeMainHorizontal/computeMainVertical in LayoutEngine. The first pane gets a configurable main-pane-size ratio (default 60%). Remaining panes share the remaining space equally. Files: internal/termmux/layout.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: LayoutMainHorizontal: first pane gets 60% of height, remaining panes share 40% equally. LayoutMainVertical: first pane gets 60% of width, remaining panes share 40% equally. Main pane ratio configurable via LayoutEngine.SetMainRatio(float64). Works with 2, 3, 5, 8 panes. At least 8 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add configurable status bar with left/right sections and window status
sequentialTasks.description: The current StatusBar renders a single reverse-video text line. Extend it with: (1) left section (status-left), (2) center section (existing title), (3) right section (status-right), (4) per-pane window status indicators (e.g., [0:name] [1:name*]), (5) configurable foreground/background colors, (6) configurable position (top/bottom). Add SetLeftStatus, SetRightStatus, SetWindowStatus, SetColors, SetPosition methods. The window status shows all panes with the active one highlighted. Files: internal/termmux/statusbar/statusbar.go, internal/termmux/statusbar/statusbar_test.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: StatusBar has left/center/right sections. Window status shows pane names with active pane highlighted. Configurable colors (foreground/background). Configurable position (top/bottom). Default position is bottom. Default colors are reverse video. At least 10 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add mouse click-to-focus pane and drag-to-resize pane border
sequentialTasks.description: Add mouse-driven pane management: (1) Click-to-focus: when a mouse click lands inside a pane's geometry (computed by LayoutEngine), that pane becomes focused. (2) Drag-to-resize: when a mouse drag starts on a pane border (within 1 cell of a divider), dragging changes the split ratio of the adjacent panes. Both features require the compositor to know pane geometries. Add HandleMouseClick(x, y) and HandleMouseDrag(x, y) methods to PaneManager that perform hit-testing and update focus/ratio. Wire these into the BubbleTea mouse event pipeline. Files: internal/termmux/pane_manager.go, internal/termmux/pane_keys.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: Clicking inside a pane focuses it. Dragging a pane border resizes the adjacent panes. Click outside any pane is a no-op. Drag that doesn't start on a border is a no-op. At least 8 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add mouse wheel scroll in copy mode
sequentialTasks.description: When copy mode is active and a mouse wheel event occurs, scroll the copy mode viewport instead of forwarding the wheel event to the child process. The scroll amount should match the wheel delta. Exit copy mode mode should restore normal wheel forwarding. Wire this into the mouse forwarding pipeline: if copy mode active and event is wheel, consume it as ScrollUp/ScrollDown instead of forwarding to PTY. Files: internal/termmux/pane_manager.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: Mouse wheel in copy mode scrolls viewport up/down. Mouse wheel outside copy mode forwards to child as SGR. Scroll amount matches wheel delta. At least 4 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add window management (new-window, next-window, rename-window)
sequentialTasks.description: tmux has a 'window' concept: each window contains multiple panes, and windows are displayed in the status bar as tabs. Add Window type (id, name, pane list, active pane, layout mode) and WindowManager that manages a list of windows within a session. Only one window is visible at a time. Window switching changes which panes are rendered. Add NewWindow, NextWindow, PrevWindow, RenameWindow, CloseWindow methods. Expose via JS bindings. Files: internal/termmux/window.go (new), internal/termmux/manager.go (integrate), internal/builtin/termmux/module.go (JS bindings).
sequentialTasks.acceptance: Window type exists with ID, name, pane list, active pane, layout. WindowManager manages list of windows. NewWindow creates a window with an initial pane. NextWindow/PrevWindow switch visible window. RenameWindow changes window name. CloseWindow closes window and all its panes. Window list shown in status bar. At least 10 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add prefix key system for command routing
sequentialTasks.description: tmux uses a prefix key (default Ctrl+B) followed by a command key to route actions. Add a PrefixKeyHandler that buffers keystrokes: when the prefix key is detected, the next key is intercepted and dispatched as a command (not forwarded to the child). Default prefix: Ctrl+B (configurable). Command table: c=new-window, n=next-window, p=prev-window, d=detach, z=zoom-pane, x=close-pane, %=split-horizontal, \"=split-vertical, [=copy-mode, ?=list-keys. This replaces the current hardcoded PaneKeyHandler. Files: internal/termmux/prefix_keys.go (new), internal/termmux/pane_keys.go (refactor or replace).
sequentialTasks.acceptance: PrefixKeyHandler intercepts prefix key and dispatches next key as command. Default prefix Ctrl+B. Command table maps 10+ keys to actions. Unrecognized command after prefix is discarded (not forwarded). When no prefix detected, all keys pass through to child. Prefix key is configurable. At least 10 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add synchronized panes (send input to all panes simultaneously)
sequentialTasks.description: Add synchronize-panes mode: when enabled, keyboard input sent to the active pane is also sent to all other panes in the same window. This is useful for running the same command on multiple servers. Add SynchronizePanes bool to paneManager and WindowManager. When Input() is called and SynchronizePanes is true, the input is written to all panes' PTYs, not just the active one. Expose via JS binding. Files: internal/termmux/pane_manager.go, internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: SynchronizePanes mode sends input to all panes, not just the active one. Toggle via JS binding. When disabled (default), only active pane receives input. Input is sent to each pane's PTY in order. Error in one pane does not block others. At least 6 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add monitoring (bell, activity, silence) and visual bell
sequentialTasks.description: Add three monitoring features: (1) MonitorBell: when a pane emits BEL (0x07), highlight the pane's status bar entry and emit a MonitorBell event. (2) MonitorActivity: when a background pane produces output after being idle for >30s, highlight its status bar entry and emit a MonitorActivity event. (3) MonitorSilence: when a pane produces no output for a configurable duration (default 0=disabled), emit a MonitorSilence event. (4) VisualBell: on BEL, flash the pane border briefly instead of (or in addition to) the audible bell. Add MonitorConfig to paneManager. Emit events via EventBus. Files: internal/termmux/pane_manager.go, internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/termmux/eventbus.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: MonitorBell event fires on BEL character. MonitorActivity event fires when background pane produces output after idle. MonitorSilence event fires when pane is silent for configured duration. VisualBell flashes pane border. All three monitors configurable per-pane. At least 8 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add remain-on-exit behavior for panes
sequentialTasks.description: When a pane's process exits, the pane currently transitions to SessionExited and is closed. Add RemainOnExit option: when true, the pane stays visible after exit, showing the final screen content. The pane's status bar entry shows [EXITED]. The user can review output and then manually close the pane (or respawn it). Add RemainOnExit bool to paneManager/WindowManager. Add RespawnPane method that creates a new session in the same pane geometry. Files: internal/termmux/pane_manager.go, internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: RemainOnExit keeps pane visible after process exit. Pane shows [EXITED] in status bar. RespawnPane creates new session in same pane geometry. Without RemainOnExit, pane closes on exit (current behavior). At least 6 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add pane swap, break, join, and zoom
sequentialTasks.description: Add four pane management features: (1) SwapPane(id1, id2): exchanges two panes' positions in the layout while keeping their sessions. (2) BreakPane(id): moves a pane out of its current window into a new window. (3) JoinPane(id, targetWindowId): moves a pane into a target window. (4) ZoomPane(id): toggles a pane between full-screen and its normal position. These require the WindowManager to be in place. Files: internal/termmux/pane_manager.go, internal/termmux/window.go (once implemented), internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: SwapPane exchanges two panes' geometries and sessions. BreakPane moves pane to new window. JoinPane moves pane into target window. ZoomPane toggles full-screen. All operations preserve session content. At least 8 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add pipe-pane for teeing pane output to external command
sequentialTasks.description: Add pipe-pane functionality: when enabled, a pane's raw PTY output is teed to an external command (or file) in addition to being processed by VTerm. This is useful for logging, recording, or real-time output analysis. Add PipeConfig to paneManager with Command string and Enabled bool. When enabled, spawn the command and pipe output to its stdin. Expose via JS binding. Files: internal/termmux/pane_manager.go, internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: Pipe-pane tees raw PTY output to configured command or file. Output still processed by VTerm normally. Pipe can be enabled/disabled at runtime. Pipe command receives all output bytes. At least 4 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add display-message for transient user notifications
sequentialTasks.description: Add a DisplayMessage function that shows a transient message to the user for a configurable duration (default 3 seconds). The message appears as an overlay on the current pane (similar to tmux's display-message). Implementation: add a message overlay to the render pipeline. When a message is active, it appears in a highlighted bar at the bottom of the pane (above the status bar). The message auto-dismisses after the duration. Expose via JS binding: termmux.displayMessage({text: '...', duration: 3000}). Files: internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: DisplayMessage shows text overlay on current pane. Message auto-dismisses after configured duration. Multiple messages queue and show sequentially. Message rendered above status bar. Exposed via JS binding. At least 4 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add choose-tree interactive session/pane selector
sequentialTasks.description: Add a choose-tree popup that displays all sessions/panes in a navigable list (similar to tmux's choose-tree). The popup overlays the terminal and allows the user to select a session or pane with arrow keys and Enter. Implement as a BubbleTea model that can be activated from JS. The chooser lists: session name, pane title, pane state (running/exited). Selecting an item focuses that pane/window. Expose via JS binding: termmux.chooseTree({onSelect: function(id) {...}}). Files: internal/builtin/termmux/chooser.go (new), internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: Choose-tree popup shows all sessions/panes. Arrow keys navigate. Enter selects and focuses. Escape cancels. Selected item highlighted. Works with multiple windows and panes. Exposed via JS binding. At least 6 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add capture-pane region selection and clipboard piping
sequentialTasks.description: Extend ScreenSnapshot with region selection: capture specific rows (startLine to endLine) instead of the full screen. Add CapturePane(sessionID, startLine, endLine) method to SessionManager that returns the selected region as plain text and ANSI. Also add automatic clipboard piping: CopyPaneToClipboard(sessionID) that copies the visible screen to the system clipboard via OSC 52. Expose via JS bindings. Files: internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: CapturePane with startLine/endLine returns only selected rows. Default (0, -1) returns full screen. CopyPaneToClipboard sends visible screen to clipboard. Region selection respects scrollback boundaries. At least 6 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add lock-session functionality
sequentialTasks.description: Add lock-session: when locked, the terminal displays a password prompt and blocks all input/output until the correct password is entered. This provides basic security for unattended terminals. Add LockSession(password) and UnlockSession(password) methods. When locked, the screen shows only a password prompt (no session content visible). After unlocking, the session resumes normally. Password is hashed with bcrypt. Expose via JS binding. Files: internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: LockSession(password) locks the session. Screen shows password prompt. UnlockSession with correct password resumes session. UnlockSession with wrong password fails. Password hashed with bcrypt. Session content hidden while locked. At least 6 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Expose copy mode, search, navigation, and all new features via JS bindings
sequentialTasks.description: Expose all copy mode and search features via the osm:termmux JS binding: enterCopyMode, exitCopyMode, selectStart, selectEnd, selectedText, copySelection, searchForward, searchBackward, nextMatch, prevMatch, pageUp, pageDown, scrollToTop, scrollToBottom, copyModeKeyHandler. Also expose window management (newWindow, nextWindow, renameWindow, closeWindow), prefix key system, synchronized panes toggle, monitoring configuration, remain-on-exit, respawn-pane, pane swap/break/join/zoom, pipe-pane, display-message, choose-tree, capture-pane, lock-session. Wire all new Go methods from previous tasks into the JS binding layer. Files: internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: All new Go methods exposed as JS functions. JS scripts can call termmux.enterCopyMode(), termmux.searchForward('pattern'), termmux.newWindow(), etc. Each JS binding has at least 1 test. All existing JS binding tests pass.

sequentialTasks.task: Add newBouncePresenter Go binding for full lifecycle management
sequentialTasks.description: Add a newBouncePresenter factory to osm:termmux that encapsulates the entire bouncing terminal lifecycle: session creation, bounce controller, control router, mouse forwarding, compositor management, chrome rendering (lipgloss styles created Go-side), tick cycle, action dispatch, and BubbleTea model interface. The presenter creates and manages: CaptureSession + SessionManager + Register/Activate, bounceController, controlRouter, compositor panes/chrome, mouse forwarding (SGR encoding, hit-testing, copy-mode wheel scroll), lipgloss styles (borderStyle, keyStyle, dimStyle, redStyle, statusBgStyle, statusValStyle, greenStyle), formatTime, stringWidth/padRight utilities. Exposed as a Goja object with handleMsg(msg) and render() methods that serve as the BubbleTea update and view functions directly. Files: internal/builtin/termmux/bounce_presenter.go (new), internal/builtin/termmux/module.go (register).
sequentialTasks.acceptance: termmux.newBouncePresenter(config) returns Goja object with handleMsg and render. handleMsg dispatches WindowSize, Tick, MouseClick, MouseMotion, MouseRelease, MouseWheel, Key, Focus, Blur, Paste. render produces view object with content, altScreen, mouseMode, windowTitle. Lipgloss styles created Go-side. Chrome rendering (controls + status) done Go-side. Script line count reduced from 225 to under 100. All existing tests pass. Build clean. Lint clean.

The script must support mouse input and all existing functionality: pause/resume, pane size adjustment, quit, chord mode, resize, compositor rendering. Files: scripts/example-15-bouncing-logo.js.

sequentialTasks.task: Add VT cursor save/restore (DECSC/DECRC) with extended attribute support
sequentialTasks.description: The current DECSC/DECRC implementation saves/restores cursor position and basic attributes. Extend it to also save/restore: character attributes (SGR), charset designations (G0-G1; G2/G3 are not supported by this VT engine), and origin mode (DECOM). This brings the implementation closer to xterm compliance. Per the DECSC/DECRC spec note in blueprint.json globalAlerts, CursorVisible and MouseTracking/MouseSGR are NOT part of the save/restore set and must remain intentionally excluded. Also fixed a bug where the virtual SearchMatch rendering hint was being saved/restored as part of SGR state. Files: internal/termmux/vt/esc.go, internal/termmux/vt/decsc_sgr_test.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: DECSC saves cursor position + SGR attributes + charset designations + origin mode. DECRC restores all saved state. CursorVisible and MouseTracking/MouseSGR NOT saved/restored (spec compliance). SearchMatch hint excluded from save/restore. At least 6 new tests verifying each saved/restored attribute.

sequentialTasks.task: Add OSC 52 clipboard integration for copy-mode selections
sequentialTasks.description: Extend the copy-mode selection flow to automatically copy selected text to the system clipboard via OSC 52 when the user presses Enter in copy mode. The current CopyPaneToClipboard sends the full visible screen; this task adds per-selection clipboard copy. Also add termmux.copySelection(sessionID), termmux.selectStart(sessionID, row, col), and termmux.selectEnd(sessionID, row, col) JS bindings. Files: internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: Copy-mode Enter copies selected text to clipboard via OSC 52. termmux.copySelection(sid) copies selection only (not full screen). selectStart/selectEnd bindings allow JS scripts to set selection bounds. Empty selection is a no-op. At least 4 tests.

continuousVerification.task: Run make build && go test -short -count=1 -timeout=5m ./... after EVERY significant change
continuousVerification.description: Execute the project's build/test pipeline after each code change.
continuousVerification.failPolicy: If ANY test fails, STOP IMMEDIATELY and fix the issue before proceeding.

finalEnforcementProtocol.alert: BUILD FIRST: Always rebuild osm before running scripts.
ZERO TOLERANCE FOR FAILURES: If tests fail, fix them before proceeding.
RULE OF TWO: Two contiguous issue-free reviews before every commit.
